articles.summary: Victor Sandor, MD, is a Non-Executive Director on the Board of Directors of ADC Therapeutics. Dr. Sandor was most recently Chief Medical Officer at Array BioPharma, Inc. prior to its acquisition by Pfizer Inc. At Array, Dr. Sandor was instrumental in obtaining the approval of Braftovi® (encorafenib) and Mektovi® (binimetinib). Prior to joining Array, he […]
